environment.description: Migration script runs as a Kubernetes CronJob in the 'data-ops' namespace. The pod has direct network access to the LDAP server on port 389. Arguments are passed from a ConfigMap that is editable by the data-ops team via kubectl. The LDAP server is OpenLDAP 2.4.57 with no query complexity limits or filter validation. The HSM (SoftHSM2) is configured but the SASL EXTERNAL bind falls back to simple bind with a static DN when client certificates are unavailable (which they are in this environment since TLS is not enforced). The pod runs as root with no seccomp profile.
